description: ol-undefined-var (issue #1005): a bare mixed-case `:SomeVar` read the checker cannot resolve reports `params.name` as the case-insensitive resolution identity `somevar`, NOT the source casing. This is the twin of `core-language/execution/undefined-var-mixed-case`: both the semantic checker (here) and the runtime guard fold the name identically, so one undefined-variable condition has one diagnostic identity (`spec/error-model.md:255-260`) whatever the source casing.
